name: Command palette (⌘K)
description: Native dialog overlay opened by button or ⌘K/Ctrl+K with live-filtered grouped results.

name: Callout / admonition boxes
description: Four tinted variants (Note, Tip, Warning, Danger) with a left accent rail, an icon, and a label. Pure CSS.

name: API reference block
description: Method pill, monospace path, params table, and cURL/JSON tabs that switch on click.

name: Integration grid
description: Filter chips above a grid of integration tiles, shown or hidden live by data-category.

name: Announcement bar
description: Faux top banner with message, inline link, and ✕ dismiss with demo reset link.

name: Theme switcher
description: Segmented System/Light/Dark control that restyles only the sample card below.

name: “Was this helpful?”
description: Small docs-footer feedback card that swaps to a thank-you state on vote.
